issues.title: Which Caterpillar product or product family is actually accused, and what...

issues.title: Does the accused machine operate as an induction generator, rather than as...
issues.question: Does the accused machine operate as an induction generator, rather than as a permanent-magnet, wound-field synchronous, switched-reluctance, or other generator?

issues.title: If an induction machine is present, is it driven above synchronous or rated...

issues.proof: Machine ratings and pole count; Measured shaft speed, electrical frequency, slip, torque, and output waveforms; Engine and generator control maps over the accused operating envelope

issues.title: What circuit couples generator output to the alleged energy reservoir, and...

issues.title: Is there a transducer-to-control-module-to-servomechanism throttle-control...

issues.proof: Sensor lists and calibration data; ECU architecture, software logic, CAN messages, and throttle or fuel-actuator commands; Dynamic testing correlating sensed variables with control outputs

issues.title: Does any energy reservoir buffer average generator power against peak load...
issues.question: Does any energy reservoir buffer average generator power against peak load demand in the claimed arrangement, and in which operating modes?
issues.proof: Energy-storage sizing and integration documents; Charge/discharge traces under representative loads; System energy-flow and operating-mode analysis

issues.title: Which claim terms require technical construction, including 'induction...
issues.question: Which claim terms require technical construction, including 'induction motor,' 'overspeed,' 'energy reservoir,' 'control module,' 'transducer,' and 'servomechanism throttle control'?

issues.title: What did pre-October 2001 systems and publications teach about self-excited...

issues.title: What testing can distinguish accused operation from noninfringing modes...

experts.name: Pragasen Pillay
experts.role: Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering and Concordia University Research Chair, Concordia University
experts.fit: The strongest direct fit for induction-machine identity, modeling, performance, and hybrid/renewable generator questions. His public profile covers electric machines and drives, traction motors for hybrid and electric vehicles, renewable energy, and storage; his professional record includes chairing the IEEE Power Engineering Society Induction Machinery Sub-Committee.
experts.work: Concordia identifies his research in modeling, analysis, design, and control of electrical machines and electric motor drives, including hybrid-electric traction and renewable energy. His teaching includes Energy Conversion, Electric Machines & Drives, Advanced Machines & Drives, Power Electronics, and Electric Machine Design.

experts.name: James R. Hendershot
experts.role: President and CEO, MotorSolver LLC; IEEE Fellow
experts.fit: Exceptional hands-on fit for identifying and testing motor/generator types and analyzing induction-machine construction. MotorSolver publicly describes prototype manufacture, final electrical testing, and dynamometer performance testing; his technical materials cover AC induction, switched-reluctance, and permanent-magnet machines.
experts.work: His public biography describes decades designing motors for hybrid vehicles, microturbines, and diesel generators, publications and tutorials on electric-machine design, and prototype/test services. An Oak Ridge National Laboratory report includes his work comparing AC induction, internal permanent-magnet, and switched-reluctance traction motors.
experts.litigation: His public CV describes expert-witness deposition/report work in a patent case, a prior-art engagement for AMETEK, and expert services in Finmeccanica v. General Motors.
experts.weakness: His published work is especially strong on practical motor design and several non-induction machine types, so a converter-controls specialist may still be needed. The public CV is dated and all listed engagements and present capacity require verification.

experts.work: Aalborg's research portal lists more than 1,300 publications and ongoing power-system work. Public AAU materials identify him as the former leader of its Wind Power Systems program and describe research in power systems, power electronics, and electric machines, including DFIG test facilities.
experts.litigation: No candidate-specific expert report, declaration, deposition, or trial-testimony source was located in the public sources reviewed.
